sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: What is the main objective of the 'Cooking Without Fire' project for school students? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The main objective is to teach students basic culinary independence, safe food handling, hygiene, and the preparation of highly nutritious meals without the dangerous risks of using open gas stoves.

questions.question_text: In Scratch animation, what is a 'script' and how is it created? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A script is a set of instructions that tells a sprite what to do. It is created by snapping together colorful programming blocks in a logical sequence within the workspace.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to group artifacts by 'theme' when organizing a Class Museum? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Grouping artifacts by theme, such as 'ancient coins' or 'traditional toys', makes the museum visually organized, allowing visitors to understand the specific historical or cultural story being told easily.

questions.question_text: You want to create a short Scratch animation where a cat walks forward, says "Hello!", and plays a 'meow' sound. List the logical order of block categories you would snap together to achieve this. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, start with an Events block (when green flag clicked) to initiate the script. Second, snap a Motion block (move 10 steps) for walking. Third, add a Looks block (say "Hello!"). Finally, attach a Sound block (play sound meow) to complete the sequence.
